info.title: PaySafe Payments API
info.description: Mobile-money payments for Tanzania. Amounts are integers in minor units; phones are E.164 (+255…). Test keys (paysafe_test_) use the deterministic sandbox provider; live keys (paysafe_live_) require a verified organisation.

servers.description: Production and sandbox (selected by key prefix)

post.description: Starts a mobile-money charge. Returns 202 with status pending; the final state arrives by webhook or by polling GET /v1/payments/{id}. Requires scope payments:write.

post.description: Issues a 12-digit pay-by-reference number for something a customer owes. The number comes only from the server. Returns 201 with the number and its hosted pay page. Requires scope payments:write and the control-numbers feature on the project (404 feature_disabled otherwise); 409 limit_reached when the project's open-number limit is hit; 400 image_invalid when image does not name an uploaded JPEG, PNG or WebP.

parameters.name: X-Request-ID
parameters.description: Client-supplied correlation id; echoed back and shown in the dashboard request log.

payer_name.description: Who owes the money. Printed on the receipt; the pay page shows initials only.

payer_phone.description: Tanzanian mobile number, local or E.164. Receives the number and receipts by SMS.

payer_reference.description: Your own id for the payer: a student number, tenant id or account number.

title.description: What the payment is for. Shown on the pay page and the receipt.

payment_type.description: Groups numbers in reports and exports, for example fees or rent.

mode.description: full: one payment of the whole balance. instalment: any number of payments until the balance is zero.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 instant, or YYYY-MM-DD for the end of that day in Tanzania. Must be in the future.

notes.description: Internal notes. Never shown to the payer.

instalments.description: Optional schedule for instalment mode: due dates in order, amounts adding up to amount.

metadata.description: Up to 8 KB of your own JSON, returned unchanged.

image.description: Storage key of an image uploaded from the dashboard (the image field of a number or batch created there). There is no upload endpoint in the API yet.
